purpose: Track Intel Crescent Island as a high-memory, air-cooled PCIe inference accelerator for large-model and agentic AI workloads.

hardware.software_note: Intel oneAPI 2026.1 lists Crescent Island GPU support on Ubuntu Server 24.04 and 26.04 with the current Intel GPU user-mode driver stack.
llm_relevance: Up to 480GB LPDDR5X creates an unusually large single-card memory-capacity tier for inference.
350W air-cooled PCIe deployment targets existing enterprise servers rather than liquid-cooled rack-only infrastructure.
Intel explicitly positions Crescent Island for token-intensive agentic inference, larger models, longer contexts and higher concurrency.
hardware.availability_note: Intel previously targeted customer sampling in the second half of 2026; its Hot Chips 2026 disclosure provides the expanded 480GB/350W specification but does not establish general retail availability.
open_questions: physical memory bandwidth and exact LPDDR5X configuration
standalone card and OEM system pricing
general availability and production shipment dates
tokens per watt at the wall
